newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 28.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's stock indices and price earnings ratios have returned to a safe area for rational investment after the government introduced a series of regulatory measures.
-Deposits in the Bank of China reached 519 billion yuan ($62.5 billion) by the end of June 1997, an increase of 30 billion yuan compared with the beginning of the year.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The value of life insurance, at a fixed annual growth rate of five percent, is too low for it to be any protection against future inflation.
